title: Refocus roadmap timelines on product availability and add consent-gated GA4
instruction: Transcribed from Sato Kento's September 6, 2026 approval to update the roadmaps according to the proposed product-availability presentation and to integrate Google Analytics 4 measurement ID G-7JB5N480MT. On the main memory-technology timeline, show only confirmed productization, volume production or commercial availability; official productization or volume targets; and items whose productization timing is not public. Retain research, standardization, prototype, sample and pilot evidence in structured click-through details. Add a planning-year view without representing past productization as guaranteed procurement availability or support. Add HBM5 only to the extent supported by official public evidence and preserve missing product timing as a Coverage Gap. Load GA4 only on the production GitHub Pages host after explicit visitor consent, send only sanitized page views without query strings or fragments, and do not collect search terms or Feedback text. Keep research outputs provisional and Consensus-incomplete. Publish the resulting Pages changes in a Pull Request against main. This directive does not authorize merging the Pull Request or publishing non-public information.
